text:
Aisha (Infra): Starting this thread for infra/capacity follow-ups from today's All-hands — GPU supply, regions, autoscale hotpaths. I'll answer live and tag folks for follow-ups. Please keep short Qs.

Leo (Platform): Are we locking priority to eu-west for next reserved slot? We saw request volume increase there.

Maria (Prod): Data: eu-west 2.1x month-over-month, apac 1.4x. Priority depends on SLA customers.

Aisha (Infra): Short: yes — EU is first for next reserved capacity (commits), APAC still on the roadmap. Reason: lower p99 latencies when colocated. We'll publish a timeline.

Sam (SRE): What about fallback behavior if eu capacity hits supply shortage? Do we route to other regions or fall back to lighter quantized variants?

Aisha (Infra): Fallback plan = route by policy -> try same-region compatible model variant -> cross-region (eu->us) as last resort. We also have auto-fallback to quantized v2 that trades perf for cost. Ops-Bot will post current routing table.

Ops-Bot: Current routing policies: eu-priority (0.75), region-fallback (0.15), model-fallback (0.1). Link: https://internal.redwood/supply/policies

Ingrid (PM): For customers with strict data residency, what's the commitment if we route cross-region?

Maria (Prod): For those customers we have region-lock (no cross-region). We'll honor contracts; autoscaler won't cross-region for region-locked tenants. Action: catalog of region-locked tenants -> export by EOD? @Sam

Sam (SRE): noted. Will produce export and drop in #eng-infra.

Leo (Platform): Autoscaling question: are we changing scale-up thresholds to be more aggressive for hotpaths?

Aisha (Infra): Yes, for hotpath models (chat-rt, embeds-hot) we lower scale-up threshold from 70% -> 55% to reduce p95 spikes. We also increased buffer nodes for burst windows. Config snippet:

```
autoscaler:
  hotpath_threshold_pct: 55
  buffer_nodes: 3
  cooldown_sec: 45
```

Maria (Prod): Any unit-cost impact?

Aisha (Infra): Small increase in idle cost (~2-3%), expected to reduce p95 latency by ~18%. We'll monitor.

Leo (Platform): Timeline to roll these autoscaler changes?

Aisha (Infra): Canary tomorrow 09:00 PST in eu-west, full rollout over 48h if no regressions. DeployBot will post canary results.

DeployBot: Canary scheduled: eu-west, 09:00 PST -> will report perf metrics to #eng-sre.

Ingrid (PM): Follow-up: can we get a short one-pager for sales/CS about what this means for customers?

Aisha (Infra): Yes — I'll draft and share in #product later today. Action items: 1) Sam export region-lock list (EOD). 2) Leo publish autoscaler RFC in #eng-platform (today). 3) Aisha draft one-pager (today). 4) Maria verify customer SLAs impacted (tomorrow).

Sam (SRE): :thumbsup: will do.

Leo (Platform): thanks — all good from my side.

Aisha (Infra): thanks everyone. If more Qs, drop here or ping me. :sparkles:
